Thought: The carbon NMR spectra indicate the presence of aromatic carbons (around 127-147 ppm) and aliphatic carbons (around 26-44 ppm). This information, combined with the proton NMR data, suggests a structure with both aromatic and aliphatic components. I will now compare these findings with the list of isomers to identify the most likely structure. The presence of both aromatic and aliphatic signals suggests a structure with a phenyl group and possibly a ketone or similar functional group.

The isomer "CC(=O)C1=CC2=C(C=C1)C=C(C=C2)O" seems to fit the NMR data, as it contains both aromatic and aliphatic components, and the chemical shifts align with the expected values for such a structure. I will validate this SMILES string to ensure it is correct.
Action: validate_smiles
